verdict.rationale: Vanta's evidence covers adjacent pieces of the story: offboarding employees in batches via the API (vanta-docs-23), collecting security awareness training evidence (vanta-docs-32), integrating with identity providers (vanta-docs-26), tracking personnel in audit scope (vanta-docs-29), and running access reviews (vanta-docs-21). Nothing in the pack shows an HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklist that ties each hire to completed training and each leaver to revoked access. Missing for 10: HRIS sync, onboarding/offboarding checklist workflow, per-leaver proof of access revocation, per-hire training completion tracking, independent corroboration.
